description: This PHP class 'FormatWithProject' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface to provide a formatted string representation of a project entity. It retrieves a project by ID using a service trait and returns the project's name if found.

classes.name: FormatWithProject
classes.description: A class that formats a project entity to its name for display or processing.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Fetches a project by ID from the associated service and returns its name if found; otherwise returns null.
